summary.text: Zachary Parker was elected Ward 5 member of the Council of the District of Columbia on November 8, 2022.

paragraphs.text: He was elected to the DC State Board of Education for Ward 5 in 2018 and served as its president beginning in 2021.
Before holding office, Parker coached DC public school administrators for eight years and taught seventh-grade math in New Orleans.
He holds a B.S. from Northwestern University and a master's degree in education policy and leadership from Teachers College, Columbia University.
